extension_name.description: Name of the extension in the browser's list of extensions and in extension stores. A product name: keep it as it is.

extension_description.message: Send downloads, links and magnet links to Ketch on this computer or a remote server.
extension_description.description: Summary of the extension in the browser's list of extensions and in extension stores. At most 132 characters.

extension_action_title.description: Tooltip of the extension's toolbar button. A product name: keep it as it is.

language_tag.description: Not shown. The BCP 47 tag of this translation's language, such as zh-CN or pt-BR: the pages' lang attribute, and how numbers are written.

menu_download_link.description: Context menu item on a link.

menu_download_image.description: Context menu item on an image.

menu_download_video.description: Context menu item on a video.

notify_sent_to.description: Notification title after a download was handed to a Ketch instance, when there are several. $NAME$ is the instance's name.

notify_sent_to_ketch.description: Notification title after a download was handed to Ketch, when there is only one instance.

notify_download_added.description: Notification text after a download was handed to Ketch, when its file name isn't known.

notify_fallback_browser.description: Notification title when Ketch couldn't take a download the browser started, so the browser downloads it. The text below says why.

notify_fallback_magnet.message: Opening the magnet link in another app
notify_fallback_magnet.description: Notification title when Ketch couldn't take a clicked magnet link, so it opens as it would without the extension. The text below says why.

notify_send_failed.description: Notification title when a link from the context menu couldn't be sent. $NAME$ is the instance's name. The text below says why.

notify_unsupported.description: Notification title when the context menu was used on something without a link Ketch can download.

notify_unsupported_stream.message: The page streams this media itself, so there is no link to download.
notify_unsupported_stream.description: Notification text below notify_unsupported, for video or audio that a page plays from data it holds itself (a blob: link).

notify_unsupported_scheme.message: Only http, https, ftp and magnet links can be sent to Ketch.
notify_unsupported_scheme.description: Notification text below notify_unsupported, for other links. http, https, ftp and magnet are link types; keep them as they are.

error_with_hint.description: An error followed by what to do about it, in notifications and on the settings page. $ERROR$ is an error without a final period, such as "Can't reach Ketch at http://nas.local:8642"; $HINT$ is a sentence, such as "Open Ketch and try again."

error_no_response.description: Error when a Ketch server didn't answer in time. $ADDRESS$ is its address.

error_unreachable.description: Error when nothing answers at a Ketch server's address. $ADDRESS$ is its address.

error_token_rejected.description: Error when a Ketch server refused the access token entered for it.

error_token_required.description: Error when a Ketch server needs an access token and none was entered.

error_http_status.description: Error when a Ketch server refused a request without saying why. $STATUS$ is the HTTP status code.

error_app_start_timeout.description: Error when the Ketch app on this computer was opened but didn't answer within 45 seconds.

error_app_not_installed.message: The Ketch app isn't set up on this computer
error_app_not_installed.description: Error when the Ketch desktop app hasn't registered itself with this browser.

error_app_unreachable.description: Error when the browser couldn't talk to the Ketch app on this computer.

error_app_not_running.description: Status in the popup and on the settings page while the Ketch app on this computer is closed. It opens by itself when a download needs it.

error_app_connect_failed.description: Error when the Ketch app on this computer reported a problem without describing it.

error_app_invalid_reply.message: The Ketch app sent an invalid reply
error_app_invalid_reply.description: Error when the Ketch app on this computer answered with something the extension can't use.

error_unsupported_link.message: Ketch can't download this kind of link
error_unsupported_link.description: Error when a link that only exists in the browser, such as a blob: or data: link, was to be sent to Ketch.

error_torrent_http.description: Error when a site refused to send a .torrent file. $STATUS$ is the HTTP status code.

error_torrent_timeout.message: Timed out fetching the torrent file
error_torrent_timeout.description: Error when a site didn't send a .torrent file in time.

error_torrent_too_large.message: The torrent file is too large
error_torrent_too_large.description: Error when a .torrent file is over 16 MB, too large to be one.

error_address_required.message: Enter the address of a Ketch server
error_address_required.description: Error when a server's address was left blank on the settings page.

error_address_invalid.description: Error for a server address that can't be read. $ADDRESS$ is what was typed.

error_address_scheme.message: The address must start with http:// or https://
error_address_scheme.description: Error for a server address of another kind, such as ftp://nas.local.

error_address_credentials.message: Put the access token in the token field, not in the address
error_address_credentials.description: Error for a server address with a user name or password in it, such as http://user:secret@nas.local.

error_not_ketch.message: This address does not look like a Ketch server
error_not_ketch.description: Error on the settings page when something answers at a server's address but it isn't Ketch.

hint_app_not_installed.message: Install the Ketch desktop app and open it once, then try again. With "ketch server", or a browser installed as a Flatpak or Snap, add Ketch as a server instead.
hint_app_not_installed.description: Hint after error_app_not_installed. "ketch server" is a command; Flatpak and Snap are Linux package formats. Keep them as they are.

hint_app_not_running.message: Ketch opens by itself when you send it a download.
hint_app_not_running.description: Hint below error_app_not_running while the Ketch app on this computer is closed.

hint_open_app.description: Hint when the Ketch app on this computer didn't answer.

hint_local_server.message: Open Ketch and choose Allow another device under Settings → Sharing, or run "ketch server".
hint_local_server.description: Hint when a Ketch server on this computer didn't answer. Settings → Sharing is a page of the Ketch app and Allow another device the button on it that starts sharing: use the app's words for them. "ketch server" is a command.

hint_remote_server.message: Check that the server is running and this address is reachable from here.
hint_remote_server.description: Hint when a Ketch server on another device didn't answer.

hint_access_token.message: Enter the access code shown in Ketch under Settings → Sharing → Advanced.
hint_access_token.description: Hint when a Ketch server needs an access token or refused the one entered. Settings → Sharing → Advanced is a page of the Ketch app and a section on it that holds the Access code, the app's name for the access token: use the app's words for them.

task_magnet_link.description: Name shown for a download from a magnet link that has no name of its own.

task_torrent.description: Name shown for a torrent download that has no name of its own.

task_downloading_of.description: State of a running download in the popup's Recent list. $DOWNLOADED$ and $TOTAL$ are sizes (size_megabytes and the like); $SPEED$ is speed_per_second.

task_downloading.description: State of a running download of unknown size. $DOWNLOADED$ is a size (size_megabytes and the like); $SPEED$ is speed_per_second.

task_paused.description: State of a paused download of unknown size.

task_paused_percent.description: State of a paused download. $PERCENT$ is how much of it is downloaded, a whole number.

task_queued.description: State of a download waiting for a free slot.

task_scheduled.description: State of a download set to start later.

task_failed.description: State of a failed download. $REASON$ is the error from Ketch, which may be in English, or task_unknown_error.

task_unknown_error.description: The reason in task_failed when Ketch gave none. Lower case because it follows "Failed:".

task_pause.description: Tooltip of a running download's button in the popup.

task_resume.description: Tooltip of a paused or failed download's button in the popup.

size_bytes.description: A size in bytes. $SIZE$ is a whole number.

size_kilobytes.description: A size in kilobytes of 1024 bytes. $SIZE$ is a number.

size_megabytes.description: A size in megabytes of 1024 KB. $SIZE$ is a number.

size_gigabytes.description: A size in gigabytes of 1024 MB. $SIZE$ is a number.

size_terabytes.description: A size in terabytes of 1024 GB. $SIZE$ is a number.

speed_per_second.description: A download speed. $SIZE$ is a size (size_megabytes and the like).

status_connected.description: Connection status in the popup and on an instance card on the settings page. $VERSION$ is Ketch's version.

status_connected_to.description: Connection status of a server that has a name of its own. $NAME$ is its name; $VERSION$ is Ketch's version.

status_connected_on.description: Connection status on an instance card on the settings page. $VERSION$ is Ketch's version; $OS$ is the operating system it runs on.

status_connected_to_on.description: Connection status on the card of a server that has a name of its own. $NAME$ is its name; $VERSION$ is Ketch's version; $OS$ is the operating system it runs on.

status_connecting.description: Status while checking whether a Ketch instance answers.

status_opening_app.description: Status while the Ketch app on this computer is being opened.

instance_this_computer.description: Name of the Ketch app on this computer in the extension's list of Ketch instances, until it is renamed, and the placeholder of its name field. Saved with the settings.

instance_name_default.description: A Ketch instance in the context menu's submenu and the popup's picker, marked as the one captured downloads go to. $NAME$ is the instance's name.

instance_name.description: Placeholder and accessible label of an instance's name field on the settings page.

instance_default.description: Label of the radio button that makes an instance the one captured downloads and magnet links go to.

instance_app_detail.message: The Ketch app on this computer. The extension opens it when a download needs it.
instance_app_detail.description: Description on the card of the Ketch app on the settings page.

instance_address.description: Label of a server's address field.

instance_token.description: Label of a server's access token field.

instance_token_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the access token field, as a server may not need one.

instance_insecure.message: This address isn't encrypted: the access token and any cookies sent with downloads travel over the network in plain text. Prefer https, or use it only on a network you trust.
instance_insecure.description: Warning on the card of a server whose address starts with http:// and isn't on this computer. https is a link type; keep it as it is.

instance_test.description: Button on an instance card that checks whether it answers, opening the Ketch app if needed.

instance_remove.description: Button that removes an instance from the extension's list.

instance_enter_address.message: Enter the address of a Ketch server.
instance_enter_address.description: Status on a new server card until an address is entered.

popup_instance_picker.description: Accessible label of the popup's menu that picks which Ketch instance to show.

popup_settings.description: Tooltip and accessible label of the popup's button that opens the settings page.

popup_open_app.description: Popup button shown while the Ketch app on this computer is closed.

popup_add_placeholder.message: Paste a link or magnet link
popup_add_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the popup's field for adding a download.

popup_add_label.description: Accessible label of the popup's field for adding a download.

popup_add_button.description: Button next to that field that sends the link to Ketch. A verb.

popup_added.description: Message after a link from the popup was added. $NAME$ is the download's name.

popup_unsupported_link.message: Enter an http, https, ftp or magnet link.
popup_unsupported_link.description: Error in the popup when what was typed isn't a link Ketch can download. http, https, ftp and magnet are link types; keep them as they are.

popup_capture.description: Popup switch that sends downloads the browser starts to Ketch.

popup_capture_target.description: Below popup_capture when there are several Ketch instances: where captured downloads go. $NAME$ is the default instance's name.

popup_recent.description: Heading of the popup's list of recent downloads.

popup_no_downloads.description: Shown in the Recent list of the popup when the instance has no downloads.

options_title.description: Title of the settings page, shown in its browser tab.

options_intro.message: Send downloads from this browser to Ketch on this computer or a remote server.
options_intro.description: Introduction at the top of the settings page.

options_saved.description: Shown at the top of the settings page for a moment after a change was saved.

options_permission.message: Ketch needs access to websites to capture their downloads, send their cookies, and reach your Ketch servers.
options_permission.description: Banner on the settings page when the browser hasn't granted access to all sites.

options_allow_access.description: Button in that banner that asks the browser for access to all sites.

options_instances.description: Heading of the settings section that lists the Ketch apps and servers downloads can go to.

options_instances_detail.message: Captured downloads and magnet links go to the default instance. Right-click a link, image or video to send it to any of them.
options_instances_detail.description: Description of the Ketch instances section.

options_add_app.description: Button that adds the Ketch app on this computer back to the list after it was removed.

options_add_server.description: Button that adds a Ketch server, such as one on another device, to the list.

options_browser_downloads.description: Heading of the settings section about downloads the browser starts.

options_capture.description: Switch that sends downloads the browser starts to Ketch.

options_capture_detail.message: Downloads you start in the browser go to Ketch instead. If Ketch can't be reached, the browser downloads them as usual.

options_min_size.message: Leave small files to the browser
options_min_size.description: Label of the field for the size below which downloads stay in the browser.

options_min_size_detail.message: Files smaller than this stay in the browser. 0 sends everything.

options_min_size_unit.description: Unit after the minimum size field: megabytes.

options_excluded.message: Sites to leave to the browser
options_excluded.description: Label of the list of sites whose downloads stay in the browser.

options_excluded_detail.message: One per line. Includes their subdomains, so example.com also covers downloads.example.com.
options_excluded_detail.description: Description of options_excluded. example.com and downloads.example.com are example site names; keep them as they are.

options_cookies.description: Switch that sends the site's cookies and the page a link was on along with each download.

options_cookies_detail.message: Lets Ketch download files that need you to be signed in. Ketch stores them with the task so it can resume it later.

options_links_notifications.description: Heading of the settings section about magnet links and notifications.

options_magnet.message: Send clicked magnet links to Ketch
options_magnet.description: Switch that sends magnet links clicked on web pages to Ketch.

options_magnet_detail.message: Alt+click a magnet link to open it in another app instead.
options_magnet_detail.description: Description of options_magnet. Alt is the key; write the click with it as the language does.

options_notify.message: Notify when a download is sent
options_notify.description: Switch that shows a notification each time a download was handed to Ketch.

options_help.description: Heading of the help section at the end of the settings page.

options_help_this_computer_detail.message: Install the Ketch desktop app and open it once, so your browsers can find it. After that, the extension opens Ketch whenever a download needs it; there is no server to turn on or token to copy.

options_help_other_device_detail.message: On that device, open Settings → Sharing and choose Allow another device. Add the device here with Add server, the address Ketch shows, such as http://192.168.1.20:8642, and the Access code under Advanced as its access token. For ketch server, set apiToken in its config.toml.
options_help_other_device_detail.description: Help text under options_help_other_device. Settings → Sharing is a page of the Ketch app on that device, Allow another device a button on it and Access code a setting in its Advanced section: use the app's words for them. Add server is options_add_server and the access token instance_token; config.toml is a file name. <b> and <code> mark bold text and code: keep the tags, and the text inside <code> as it is.

options_help_command_line_detail.message: To use ketch server on this computer, or from a browser installed as a Flatpak or Snap, which can't start other apps, add it as a server at http://127.0.0.1:8642.
options_help_command_line_detail.description: Help text under options_help_command_line. Flatpak and Snap are Linux package formats. <b> and <code> mark bold text and code: keep the tags, and the text inside <code> as it is.

diagnostics_detail.message: Check uncertain submissions or export the last 100 outcomes. The report contains no URLs, file names, cookies or access tokens.

error_handoff_uncertain.message: Ketch may have accepted this download. Check pending downloads in extension settings before trying again or resuming it in the browser.

popup_pause_capture.description: Popup button that pauses automatic download and magnet capture until the user resumes.

popup_resume_capture.description: Popup button that resumes automatic capture.

popup_pause_detail.message: Temporarily leave downloads and magnet links to the browser.
popup_pause_detail.description: Popup explanation of the temporary capture pause.

popup_capture_pause_failed.message: Could not update the pause. Try again.
popup_capture_pause_failed.description: Popup error when saving or ending a temporary pause fails.

popup_capture_paused.message: Automatic capture is paused until you resume.
popup_capture_paused.description: Popup status while automatic capture is paused until the user resumes.

menu_pause_capture.description: Checkbox in the Ketch context submenu, checked while automatic download and magnet capture is paused. Unchecking resumes capture.

menu_download_directly.description: Ketch context-menu action that downloads the clicked link or media in the browser, bypassing Ketch for this download only.

notify_direct_failed.message: Could not start the browser download
notify_direct_failed.description: Notification title when a direct browser download cannot be started.

notify_direct_hint.message: Use the browser’s built-in save command for this item.
notify_direct_hint.description: Notification guidance when a direct download fails or cannot preserve the private browsing context.

instance_cookies.message: Allow cookies and referrer for this server
